C-FIX-009-RECENTLY-CLOSED.Name: FIX-009 current run: session-scoped "Recently closed" tab history with strip button, welcome recovery and ⇧⌘T
C-FIX-009-RECENTLY-CLOSED.Summary: Recovery of tabs closed during the current run becomes a bounded, session-scoped history of restorable saved-file tabs: a compact button with a count beside the tab strip's + opens a popover that reopens one entry or "Reopen all N" (and clears the list); when the final tab closes, the welcome screen exposes the same recovery prominently; Shift+Cmd/Ctrl+T reopens entries newest to oldest. Entries are deduplicated by pathname to the newest close, consumed when their file is opened by any path, hold enough ordering/active metadata for deterministic Reopen all, are bounded, and start empty on every cold launch. Untitled unsaved drafts stay outside; workspace-root removal is not a closed-tab event.
C-FIX-009-RECENTLY-CLOSED.ApprovalBasis: Owner decision recorded verbatim in the 2.5.x-next train ledger, FIX-009 entry, 2026-10-20: "once the window is running, closing tabs changes the live session, including legitimately reaching zero tabs. Recovery is provided by a separate session-scoped 'Recently closed' history… A compact history button with a count appears beside the tab strip's +; its popover can reopen one entry or 'Reopen all N'. When the final tab closes, the welcome screen exposes the same current-run recovery prominently. Shift+Cmd+T reopens entries from newest to oldest." History semantics quoted in the same entry (consume on restore or independent open; deduplicate to the newest entry; preserve root, ordering and active-tab metadata; bound the list; clear on next cold launch; unsaved untitled drafts excluded; workspace-root removal separate). Design reference: work/recently-closed-tabs-mockup.png (owner-approved dark-theme mockup: count-badged ↺ button left of +, popover with header + Clear, filename rows with root · relative time, Reopen all N footer). EP-05 approves the two-bundle split; this is the current-run half.
C-FIX-009-RECENTLY-CLOSED.ProblemEvidence: Same FIX-009 report: after closing all tabs mid-run, the only advertised recovery ("Last session") is the stale no-op fixed by C-FIX-009-SESSION-COLD-START; no current-run recovery exists at all — a tab closed by accident is reachable only through the Recent files list, losing ordering and the active-tab context. The train names the verification gap: no coverage of individual/all current-run recovery, repeated close/reopen cycles, missing files, or the separation from workspace-root removal.

Goals.Goal: A new session-scoped store records every closed tab that has a pathname, capturing pathname, filename, the tab's strip index at close, whether it was the active tab, its workspace root and the close timestamp; repeated closes of one pathname keep only the newest entry; the list is bounded (25) and lives only in memory, so a cold launch starts empty.

A count-badged history button renders left of the tab strip's + whenever the history is non-empty; its popover lists entries (filename, root · relative time), reopens one entry on click, offers "Reopen all N" in the footer and a Clear action in the header; Escape and outside-click close it.

When the final tab closes, the welcome screen shows the same recovery prominently: newest entry as the primary "Reopen closed tab" action with the ⇧⌘T hint, the remaining entries as rows, and "Reopen all N".
Shift+Cmd/Ctrl+T (File › Reopen Closed Tab) reopens the newest entry; each press consumes it and the next press reopens the next, newest to oldest.

Opening a history file by any path (popover, ⇧⌘T, Reopen all, Recent files, Open dialog, drag-drop, clipboard) consumes its entry; a missing file on reopen drops its entry with a visible notice and, for Reopen all, continues with the rest.

Reopen all is deterministic and honest: only isFile===true entries are candidates, the reopened count reports successful opens (a failed invoke is neither counted nor consumed), files reopen in ascending recorded strip order, and the re-selection targets the newest was-active entry among SUCCESSES (fallback: the last successfully reopened entry) so a selection event never names a tab that failed to open.

Constraints.Constraint: Record only in FORCE_CLOSE_TAB (the single funnel every close path already uses); untitled tabs (no pathname) are never recorded.
Workspace-root removal must not write history entries — the project-store removal path does not call FORCE_CLOSE_TAB and this bundle adds no hook there.
The store is renderer memory only — no new persisted preference, no IPC surface, no backend change beyond the menu item.
Reuse the existing open path (mt::open-file → mt::open-new-tab) for reopening; do not build a parallel tab-creation path.
The popover follows the FIX-007 float-token styling conventions (dark-theme safe, tokens not literals).

NonGoals.NonGoal: No recovery of unsaved untitled drafts (train: "until a durable draft mechanism exists").
No workspace-root removal undo — separate affordance, separate bundle.
No cross-window sharing: the history is per window session.
No persistence across launches — "clear it on the next cold launch" is satisfied by construction.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit: record/dedup-to-newest/consume-on-any-open/bound-25/clear semantics pinned, including repeated close/reopen cycles and strip-order + active metadata for Reopen all.
Component: the strip button renders only when non-empty with the exact count; the popover shows rows + Reopen all N + Clear; reopening one/all consumes entries; Escape/outside-click close.
Welcome recovery block appears exactly when zero tabs and history non-empty; its actions share the store paths.
Missing file on reopen: entry dropped, localized notice, Reopen all continues.

⇧⌘T reopens newest→oldest through repeated presses; the menu item and command palette entry agree; the chord never reaches the editor when history is non-empty; with empty history it is a no-op without stealing keys.
Browser e2e: close-to-zero → welcome recovery → Reopen all restores order and active tab; ⇧⌘T cycle; dedup on repeated close.

AffectedAreas.Area: src/renderer/src/store/recentlyClosed.js (new, TEST+RUNTIME contract); src/renderer/src/store/editor.js (FORCE_CLOSE_TAB records; NEW_TAB_WITH_CONTENT/arrival consumes); src/renderer/src/bootstrap-ipc.js (open-new-tab consumes); src/renderer/src/components/editorWithTabs/tabs.vue (button + popover); src/renderer/src/components/recent/index.vue (recovery block); src/renderer/src/commands/index.js (file.reopen-closed-tab); src-tauri/src/m009_menu.rs (File › Reopen Closed Tab, Shift+CmdOrCtrl+T); static/locales/*.json (10 locales); tests (unit, component, e2e); .grace graph/verification updates; train record.
